sources.title: google/gemma-4-31B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B. Their diverse sizes make them deployable in environments ranging from high-end phones to laptops and servers, democratizing access to state-of-the-art AI. sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. sources.snippet: Kannada OCR Fine-Tuning Dataset Fine-tuning dataset for training vision-language models to read handwritten Kannada text from historical birth and death register images.

sources.title: Vision understanding | Gemma | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4, the latest model from the Gemma family, can perform a wide range of vision-language tasks such as object detection, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), visual question answering, image captioning, and reasoning across multiple images.

sources.title: Gemma 4 31B — Enterprise-Grade Local LLM | gemma4.dev
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B is Google's flagship Gemma 4 model with 31B parameters and 256K token context. Ideal for production RAG pipelines, long-document analysis, and enterprise inference servers.
